priceHelp: 先填统一价格，也可逐行修改；留空表示价格待定。保存前请检查单色与整套价格。
Set one price or edit rows individually. Blank means unpriced. Check single-colour and full-set prices before saving.
shared: 同一组图片用于所选商品
Use the same photos for selected products
matchHelp: 例如 A11.jpg、A11_1.jpg、A11_2.jpg 会匹配 A11。匹配不唯一时请手动选择，或移除该文件。
A11.jpg, A11_1.jpg and A11_2.jpg match A11. Select a product manually for ambiguous matches, or remove the file.
sharedHelp: 这些图片将用于所有符合条件的已选商品。请核对预览后保存。
These photos will be used for all eligible selected products. Review the preview before saving.
onlyMissing: 只给当前缺图商品配图
Apply photos only where photos are missing
unmatched: 还有图片未匹配商品，请选择对应商品或移除文件。
Some photos are unmatched. Choose their products or remove the files.
tooMany: 每次最多选择500张图片，每件商品最多12张。
Choose up to 500 photos per batch and up to 12 per product.
tooLarge: Each photo must be no larger than 12 MB.
conflict: 有商品已被其他操作更新，本次没有保存任何商品。请重新打开批量编辑后再试。
A product was changed elsewhere. No products were saved. Reopen bulk editing and try again.
skipped: 已有图片，按当前设置跳过
Already has photos; skipped by current setting
priceAndPhoto: 售价与图片可一起保存；有一条冲突时整批不会覆盖。
Save prices and photos together. A conflict prevents the whole batch from overwriting newer edits.
